description: EduBehaviors is an interpretable annotation framework in which researchers write explicit binary assertions about conversational behavior; LLMs annotate each assertion as true or false, and a rule or trained statistical model combines these values into a construct label.
title: EduBehaviors

description: The article proposes using the education polygenic score (education-PGS), a composite of genetic variants associated with completing more years of school, as a \"molecular tracer\" of students through the high school math pipeline.
title: Education polygenic-score molecular-tracer method for studying student pathways

description: Beyond teaching-method types, the review analyzes interventions through three educational characteristics.
title: Educational characteristics framework for analyzing democracy-teaching interventions
